scope: Corollary 5.6 of the manuscript “Power-law violations of Yau's nodal upper bound” (preprints/Power-law-violations-of-Yaus-nodal-upper-bound-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b8b6757d7a3a49d7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer n > 5 there is a smooth closed connected n-dimensional Riemannian manifold and a fixed ϵ0 > 0 with the same divergence of nodal measure divided by λ1/2+ϵ0 .
